maya: FYI customer ACME reported a 60k credit drop overnight, says it happened during their nightly vectorize job. :eyes:
leo: Which endpoint? embeddings or rerank?
devon: Logs show a flurry of requests to /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank around 02:14 UTC, lots of 502s followed by retries.
maya: They were on free-trial credits + promo. Customer claims they didn't change the job.
kelsey: Possible duplicate fanout from the scheduler? Last month we saw a similar pattern when the callback ack path returned 500 and workers requeued.
maya: Sharing a stripped log snippet from their support bundle:
```
2026-03-17T02:13:58Z INFO batcher: dispatch batch size=64 req_id=... endpoint=/v1/embeddings
2026-03-17T02:14:01Z ERROR upstream: 502 Bad Gateway path=/v1/embeddings latency=110ms
2026-03-17T02:14:01Z WARN worker: retrying request id=... attempt=1
2026-03-17T02:14:02Z ERROR upstream: 502 Bad Gateway path=/v1/embeddings latency=120ms
2026-03-17T02:14:02Z WARN worker: retrying request id=... attempt=2
2026-03-17T02:14:03Z INFO batcher: dispatched duplicate batch id=... count=3
```
leo: That looks like the worker retried without idempotency keys, so downstream saw multiple distinct requests and billed each.
devon: Confirmed: their scheduler sets no `Idempotency-Key` for background vectorize tasks (old lambda). If the client treats each retry as a fresh request, billing counts multiply.
maya: Repro steps I suggested to customer:
1) run their nightly job against staging with our test key
2) force a 502 from the staging proxy (short-circuit)
3) observe whether the client library re-sends without `Idempotency-Key`
I included a quick curl to simulate:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["a","b"]}'
```
kelsey: Small patch we can recommend: add `Idempotency-Key: job-<job_id>-<payload-hash>` on the client side and make the worker honor it for retries. Also add the `x-redwood-retry-count` header so we can short-circuit duplicate billing in the proxy.
leo: For now I've provisionally issued a 60k credit refund to the account (ticket #SUP-4821) pending root-cause. Notified finance. :thumbsup:
maya: Customer responded, appreciates the refund and will run the repro tonight. They asked if we can add a short-term server-side mitigation to dedupe identical embed batches within a 10s window.
devon: We can add a heuristic: if the batch payload hash matches and sender key matches within 15s, drop/ack duplicates and return a 200 with existing result id. Risk: false dedupe across legit replays; but OK for a temporary measure.
kelsey: I'll open a small PR to infra proxy to respect `Idempotency-Key` and to maintain a short LRU cache of recent payload hashes. Patch will include a metric `proxy.dedupe_hits`.
ops-bot: deploy-bot pushed staging-proxy/v0.4.7 to staging at 2026-03-17T09:12UTC :rocket:
maya: Re: billing, can we add a guardrail: non-production keys (free-trial) should have stricter retry dedupe for 24h to avoid big accidental burns?
leo: Agreed. I'll add a billing rule: if key tier == trial and estimated cost delta > 1k tokens/min then auto-apply temporary throttle and flag for review.
maya: Great. I'll follow up with the customer once they run the repro and confirm refunds. Thanks team. :heart:
